notes.D: px at 1280-long-side scale: threshold in original px = D*max(W,H)/1280 (px_mode s1280). For :native jobs px_mode orig (D in original px) is also given.
notes.snap_full: inside a box -> centre of smallest containing box; else within D of nearest box edge -> that box centre; else unchanged
notes.snap_outside_only: inside any box -> unchanged; else within D of nearest box -> that box centre
notes.near_miss_before: misses whose point is within 20 px (1280 scale) of the target box
notes.detections: long side resized to 1280, conf>=0.05 cached, thresholds applied afterwards
